tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to soothe, still, stroke
1a) (Piel) to soothe, still
1b) (Hiphil) stilling (participle)

1) to laud, praise, commend
1a) (Piel)
1a1) to laud, praise (God)
1a2) to commend, congratulate (the dead)
1b) (Hithpael) to boast
Aramaic equivalent: she.vach (שְׁבַח "to praise" H7624)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to address in aloud tone, i.e. (specifically) loud; figuratively, to pacify (as if by words)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: commend, glory, keep in, praise, still, triumph.
